description: A static page with no CSP, no nosniff, no referrer policy and nothing against framing. The first fixture for VC020, VC027 and VC056. The fixes for all three were rewritten: the CSP suggestion is now built from the page (its script origins and inline scripts) instead of a fixed policy that blocked this page's import map and SDK, and the nosniff and framing fixes name the HTTP header, because browsers ignore both as <meta> tags.
